entityFieldPolicy: All five complete canonical Driver records,10 RELATED_SEARCH aliases and empty crosswalk reviewed. Definitions, mechanisms, scales/types, polarity, timing/lag/persistence, volatility/modifiability, measurements/caveats, sources and narratives/interactions preserved. No blocked local fields repaired.
rdsReview: No local RDS or incident RDS endpoint. Composite scores remain measurements, not authorization to reclassify. PSY-071/073 multidimensional fields preserved; same Layer scope escalation, no direct RDS/state target.
causalGateReview: All3existing propositions STANDARD_CAUSAL. Independent measurement/temporal evidence required despite Driver status; REL-PSY-036 retains PSY-F09 source ownership.

layersConsidered.BIO: Acute stress/food devaluation and reward/avoidance experiments; original and failed replications differ by assay and control performance.
layersConsidered.PSY: Habit, intention, cue association, automaticity and expectancy separated; goals can coexist with learned cue-driven responding.
layersConsidered.SOC: Observation of others and learned expectations; imitation/efficacy not expected action-outcome probability.
layersConsidered.CUL: Culture/context stability considered in search; no adequately aligned exact cultural-Driver contrast found.
layersConsidered.ENV: Relocation/context disruption and opportunity changes affect expression versus association; matched relocation not randomized.
layersConsidered.INS: Household sustainability/health protocols and smoking restrictions as context, not exact institutional cause of habit deletion.
layersConsidered.INF: If-then plans, modeled cues/consequences and feedback; information operation not guaranteed internal uptake.
layersConsidered.TEC: App prompts and commitments in micro-randomized trial; package, notifications and behavioral traces not interchangeable habit constructs.

domainsConsidered.DELIBERATE_INTERVENTION: Cue-linked repetition, if-then planning, combined coping planning and app-support packages screened; two reusable atomic operations only.
domainsConsidered.ROUTINE_UNINTENDED_HUMAN_ACTIVITY: Repeated everyday behavior and changing cue opportunities considered; frequency not habit.
domainsConsidered.EXTERNAL_EVENT_SHOCK: Relocation/disruption/stress context; occurrence does not prove latent habit erasure.
domainsConsidered.ENVIRONMENTAL_EXPOSURE: Stable locations, routines and opportunity removal; expression and acquisition differ.
domainsConsidered.INSTITUTIONAL_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE: Rules and household-intervention settings considered; no policy efficacy from a lab/cue operation.
domainsConsidered.TECHNOLOGICAL_CHANGE: HabitWalk prompts/commitment components distinguished from exact daily repetition effect.
domainsConsidered.SOCIAL_NETWORK_EVENT_PROCESS: Observational learning, modeled consequences and contact/context changes considered; no social tie is a PSYWERX Relationship.
domainsConsidered.INFORMATIONAL_EXPOSURE: Cue-response plan encoding and observation information; no generic context EffectAssertion target.
domainsConsidered.BIOLOGICAL_PHYSIOLOGICAL_PROCESS: Stress physiology, reward/devaluation and habit-goal competition; no clinical inference or causal endocrine pathway.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Repetition/habit candidate remains RN: within-person improvement, successful-learner selection and assay limitations do not identify universal causal habit gain.
driverLedgers.gaps: SRHI includes repetition, automaticity and identity items; SRBAI removes some contamination but remains self-report. Devaluation insensitivity can also reflect deficient goal-directed control.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach/subgroups, unintended effects and interaction considered. No universal benefit, duration, synergy or antagonism inferred; unknown is not zero and nondetection not equivalence.

driverLedgers.noFinding: Layer feature-scope blocker applies; no whole multidimensional automaticity increase or scalar composite identity forced.
driverLedgers.gaps: A four-item self-report subscale does not demonstrate all speed/interference/awareness facets. Habit composites containing the same items cannot independently cause their own subscale.
driverLedgers.qualifiers: Reach/subgroups, unintended effects and interaction considered. No universal benefit, duration, synergy or antagonism inferred; unknown is not zero and nondetection not equivalence.

relationshipPropertyReview: All3edges locally reviewed before PassB. Stress, goal strength/activation, cue specificity and competing goals considered; no exact governed-edge effect/moderation or pathway established. Correlational SRBAI intention-behavior interaction is not sufficient causal moderation. No B/C contribution duplication.
propertyPolicy: All11 properties considered. Two effects UNKNOWN; LEVEL not signed for whole PSY-071/073 profiles. Timing/plateau and functional-shape estimates are descriptive fitted trajectories, not authorized numeric execution. No unsupported SUPPORTED_NULL or structure effect.
identityReview: Production14HappeningTypes/9Interventions and12earlier Layer identities compared. General cue-linked behavioral practice differs from n-back/free recall; if-then encoding differs from goal choice, refutation, repetition of messages and combined coping planning. No duplicate existing identity found; efficacy not identity.

skepticalReview.method: Second pass after drafting focused on shared item content, pre/post versus randomized estimands, assay failures, package components and source identity.
checks: Habit scale and automaticity subscale cannot be independent causal proof; no retyping implemented.
Lally curve selection and Keller successful-learner durations do not establish universal66day rule.
Keller active-cue null and Singh pre/post synthesis retained without causal upgrading.
DeWit failed induction and Smeets invalid critical shift test do not prove no habits exist; Zwosta null retained separately.
Webb mediation and goal performance not exact cue-link causality; SRC120 identity mismatch uncorrected.
Observational pain intensity not automatic action-outcome probability; multidimensional reinforcement not reward amount alone.
skepticalReview.remainingRisks: Abstract-heavy access, exact priming/latent-habit alignment and full package/assay contrasts remain unresolved. No effect considered activatable; no scientific status promotion from low candidate yield.
